name: Finsch's Francolin
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed in congo, southwestern democratic republic of the congo and central angola
description: Medium-sized francolin with a mostly gray body, rufous head, and white throat. Found locally on the ground in grassy habitats including savanna, montane grassland, and woodland.

name: Ayacucho Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (ayacucho)
description: Poorly known thistletail found only in a small area of the high Andes east of the city of Ayacucho in southern Peru. It is brown above, gray below, with a long wispy tail and a reddish-orange chin patch.

name: Brown Snake-Eagle
rangeDescription: Senegambia to northern ethiopia and southward to south africa
description: A medium-sized, brown eagle with yellow eyes, a large angular head, pale legs, and a brown-and-white-banded tail. In flight, the brown-and-silver underwing pattern is distinctive.

name: Bornean Stubtail
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo (kinabalu to liang kubung)
description: Minute, ground-dwelling warbler of Borneo’s central mountain ranges. Scurries about like a rodent in the undergrowth, where it can be difficult to see well; note bright orangish brow stripe, brown back, and gray sides.

name: Rufous-breasted Sabrewing
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southeastern venezuela and adjacent northwestern brazil
description: Large, conspicuous hummingbird of tepui highlands. Green above and rufous below.
imageCreditName: Jhonathan Miranda - Wandering Venezuela Birding Expeditions

name: Greater Yellow-Finch
rangeDescription: Andes of northern and central chile and adjacent argentina
description: Fairly common in the Andes of central Chile and adjacent Argentina; seen readily at ski resorts, around villages, on bogs, and on stony and grassy slopes. Often in flocks, associates readily with other seed-eating birds.

name: Short-tailed Paradigalla
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed mountains of western and central new guinea
description: A medium-sized, short-tailed bird of montane forest. All black plumage with iridescence on the head, fairly long bill and a distinctive, yellow wattle between the eye and the bill.

name: Taiwan Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Highlands of taiwan
description: Very small endemic songbird with tiny bill and disproportionately large head. Gray above and below, with rich rufous wings, tail, and lower flanks, white throat stippled in brown, and yellow eye.

name: Sumatran Shortwing
rangeDescription: Mountains of sumatra
description: A small, dark songster of montane rainforest floor and undergrowth on Sumatra. Male is overall dark slaty-gray but slightly paler on the belly.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Bare-throated Bellbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (alagoas) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Males are unmistakable snow-white cotingas with a greeny-blue bare face and throat. Females are olive-green above with a streaked belly and gray-brown head.

name: Sun Parakeet
rangeDescription: Guyana, suriname, and northern amazonian brazil
description: Striking parakeet, mostly yellow with a red-orange face, green wing coverts, and blue-green flight feathers. Occurs in savanna regions adjacent to tall forest and is often observed near forest edge or along rivers.

name: Madagascar Harrier-Hawk
rangeDescription: Woodland and savanna of madagascar
description: Large gray raptor with black wings and tail. There is a single white band through the tail and bare skin around the face that is normally yellow but which can flush bright red.

name: Whinchat
rangeDescription: Western palearctic; winters to tropical and southern africa
description: Male distinctive, with bold white eyebrow, dark cheeks, and peachy-orange breast. Female duller but with a ghosting of the male’s pattern, especially the pale eyebrow.

name: Cinnamon Bittern
rangeDescription: India to southeastern asia, philippines, and indonesia
description: Small heron of wet and open grassy areas such as flooded meadows and paddy fields. Uniformly bright rufous upperparts of adult male unmistakable.

name: Morningbird
rangeDescription: Palau (babelthuap to peleliu)
description: A rather small, mostly drab passerine. Male has a brownish-olive body with a darker hood and chest and a thick dark bill.

name: Purple-bibbed Whitetip
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of western colombia to southwestern ecuador and northwestern peru
description: Scarce hummingbird found in cloud forest along the west slope of the Andes. Both sexes are mostly green with a short, white line behind eye.

name: Black-cowled Saltator
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of southern ecuador and northwestern peru
description: Handsome gray-and-black cloud forest bird with a stout orange bill. It has a very restricted range in the Andes of northwestern Peru and southwestern Ecuador.

name: Hose's Broadbill
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed submontane forest of northern and central borneo
description: Uncommon and elusive green broadbill. Both sexes distinguished from other Bornean green broadbills by blue wash on belly; it is bright ultramarine in males and paler blue in females.

name: Halmahera Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (morotai, halmahera, bacan, and kasiruta)
description: A thrush-sized bird with a fairly long horn-colored bill. Uniform rich olive-green above and all yellow underneath, with dark eyes.

name: Bahama Oriole
rangeDescription: Andros (bahamas); formerly also great and little abaco, where extirpated in 1990s
description: A sleek inhabitant of wooded areas that will venture into gardens and parks in search of flowers and fruit; prefers areas with palms. The adult is distinctive with a black back, head, and chest contrasting with a bright yellow to yellow-orange belly, rump, and shoulders.
